modules.module_title: Review customer's requirement and prepare for colour matching

pcs.pc_description: identify customer's requirement of paint quality, quantity and colour
identify the colour code from the manufacturer's colour/ shade card
look up the manufacturer's colour formula in the system using the colour code
identify the base and colourants along with the quantities required
check the inventory of the required base and colourants
follow SOP for switching on the colour mixing/ tinting machine and reloading the colourants, if required

modules.module_title: Operate the colour mixing/ tinting machine and match the colour

pcs.pc_description: set the quantity, of the colourants to be added to the base, on the colour mixing/ tinting machine, as per the manufacturer's formula
load the recommended base tin on the colour mixing/ tinting machine platform, under the nozzle
select the correct formula based on the quantity required, in case of an automatic tinting machine, where the colourants will be discharged into the base, by a click on the computer
operate the colour mixing/ tinting machine as per the operating manual/ SOP
remove the tin after completion of the colourant dispensing, firmly close the lid and place the tin in a mixing machine for mixing of the colourants into the base
compare the prepared colour with the customer's requirement

modules.module_title: Clean up and maintain the machine

pcs.pc_description: clean up the work place and place waste into appropriate waste bins or rubbish stock piles
clean the nozzles on the colour mixing/ tinting machine as per SOP
maintain the colourant quality in the colour mixing/ tinting machine by intermittent mixing as per SOP
measure the dispensed quantity of the colourant, at regular interval, to ensure the right quantity is being dispensed
carry out preventive maintenance of the colour mixing/ tinting machine as per SOP
periodically update the software/ data provided by the manufacturers

nos_units.nos_title: Undertake counter sales and manage inventory
kus: KU1. dealer's policy and work instructions on quality standards
KU2. importance of individual's role in the work flow
KU3. occupational health and safety standards
KU4. sale and credit policy of the dealer
KU5. types of paint products, colourants and other materials in stock
KU6. updating sales and inventory data
KU7. inventory management of stock keeping units (SKU)
KU8. material handling equipment for material movement
KU10. common customer complaints about paints or service
gs: GS1. read customer requirements, order list, bill of materials
GS2. write reports and maintain records as per organizational policy
GS3. communicate with the customers, colleagues and suppliers in a pleasant, polite, calm and clear manner
GS4. practice active listening to capture customer requirement
GS5. identify and address stock discrepancy during inventory auditss
GS6. optimise safe usage of storage area

pcs.pc_description: show colour combinations, finish and texture/ design to the customer, using shade/ colour cards and texture/ design booklets
communicate clearly with the customer using verbal/ non-verbal communication
address customer queries and provide accurate information
assist the customer in calculating the quantity of paint and materials required for a given area
check the inventory of the required materials
process the transaction and generate the sales invoice, collect the payment and deliver the materials
assist the customer to locate a painter, if requested
record the sale in the sales register and update the stock register
prepare purchase orders for materials low in stock vis-a-vis inventory norms, to prevent stock out
inspect the incoming stock against the purchase order and update the stock register
store the received materials in their designated location, following FIFO norms
conduct regular inventory audits and report stock discrepancy, if any
maintain cleanliness and safety of the storage area
